children: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said in an interview on Bloomberg Television on Tuesday that his office was looking into aspects of the scandal that has engulfed Nvidia and its former chief executive officer, Jensen Huang.
Bonta described the situation as "very possibly" something his office could examine, adding that "red flags have been raised", as per the Bloomberg News report that featured the interview.
He did not elaborate on his concerns and said that his office was in the process of determining if "the law and facts justify" taking any action, the report said.
